The organization aggregator should wait for the Config-for-Organizations IAM policy attachment, which grants the role the permissions it needs; the provider's documented example explicitly orders the aggregator after this attachment.

The organization-scoped AWS Config aggregator should not be created before the AWS Organizations organization is established; its source uses organization aggregation and AWS Config requires the master account and an organization with all features enabled.

This CloudTrail is configured as an organization trail, so it requires the AWS Organizations organization (and its CloudTrail service integration) to be established before creation; the module has no dependency on the organization resource.
